paper_id: TBCNN_ A Tree-Based Convolutional Neural Network for Programming Language Processing
title: TBCNN: A Tree-Based Convolutional Neural Network for Programming Language Processing
motivation: 深度学习在NLP等领域成功但未应用于编程语言处理
problem_framing: 如何用深度神经网络处理程序中的树结构信息
key_insight: 将任意子树视为二叉树以处理节点数可变的AST
method_signature: TBCNN: 编码准则+树卷积+三路池化
evaluation_criteria: 程序分类准确率与向量表示聚类质量
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: RNN无法有效训练，仅学习标签分布而非结构特征
evidence_for_taste: we are the first to analyze programs by deep neural networks
RNN is not trained effectively in our setting
RNN merely learns a distribution over labels
TBCNN and BOW capture different aspects of programs
thinking_moves: 指出自然语言的嵌套结构不同于编程语言的显式树结构
通过RNN失败案例反推出信息瓶颈问题
用连续二叉树统一处理不同形状子树
结合结构特征与统计特征(BOW)验证互补性
cites_own_work: Mou et al. 2014 arXiv preprint on building program vector representations
